free_tier.stated: no free custom-domain mailbox: Mailo Free has a 1 GB mailbox and no custom domain names; Premium at €1.50 per month adds custom domains, a 20 GB mailbox and 5 GB of cloud storage
free_tier.notes: Premium is bought for 1 to 5 years; a 4-month trial offer without commitment is offered at signup, its terms unverified: behind a sign-up. Family is €3 per month for up to 5 Premium accounts in a Family space, and Pro Start €3.60 per month with tax for 2 accounts sharing 50 GB. Declaring an external domain is free; a domain bought at Mailo starts at €15 per year with tax.

per_object_cap.stated: 50 MB of attachments per message on Premium, 25 MB on Free; larger files are sent as download links, up to 1 GB on Premium and 500 MB on Free

retention.stated: a 20 GB mailbox on Premium; a full mailbox refuses new mail; a Premium account is never deleted for inactivity, a Free account after 365 days without access

egress.terms: not applicable: a mailbox; unverified: no hourly or daily sending cap is published on the captured pages

interface_detail: IMAP at mail.mailo.com (993, SSL/TLS; 143 answers with an IMAP4rev1 banner offering STARTTLS) and SMTP at mail.mailo.com (465, SSL/TLS; 587 also answers); POP3 on subscribed accounts only; ActiveSync; CalDAV, CardDAV and WebDAV
tooling: any IMAP or SMTP client, with the full address as username; application passwords are supported
chaining: a domain registered elsewhere is declared in a Mailo space free of charge, with its DNS records changed at the registrar, or a domain is bought at Mailo from EUR 15 per year with tax; a single mailbox on that domain then takes the Premium offer.

limits.value: unverified: no hourly or daily sending cap is published; the SMTP relay is subject to technical limitations whose numbers are not published
20 GB mailbox and 5 GB cloud storage on Premium
50 MB of attachments per message on Premium

binding_note: the 20 GB Premium mailbox binds: when it is full, new mail is refused; no hourly or daily sending cap is published, so whether one binds sooner is unverified.

identity_cost.detail: signup asks for a last name, a first name and a date of birth, all compulsory, a gender, a security question or rescue email address, and a computed proof-of-work check, with no phone field; accounts are for ages 13 and above. The subscription is paid online by bank card or PayPal.

reliability_note: a full mailbox refuses new mail and the sender receives a non-delivery notice
confidence_note: plans and prices read from the vendor pages; mail.mailo.com:143 answered with an IMAP4rev1 banner and mail.mailo.com:587 with an ESMTP banner; no login or send was made
